description: This file contains the implementation of an error handler for the ADOdb database abstraction layer, with support for PEAR error handling. It includes error handling functions, global error state, and configuration options specific to PEAR integration.

classes.name: PEAR_Error
classes.description: A class from PEAR used for error representation and handling.

methods.name: ADODB_Error_PEAR
methods.description: Error handler function called on database errors, constructs a PEAR_Error object.

methods.name: ADODB_PEAR_Error
methods.description: Function returning the last PEAR_Error object generated by the handler.
